data.name: Lussuria
data.description:
Gender Male
Age 27
Birthdate April 4
Organization Vongola
Team Varia
Weapon Muay Thai, Steel Knee
Flame Sun
Blood Type A
Height 185 cm
Weight 78 kg

Lussuria (ルッスーリア, Russūria), or Luss (ルッスー Russū) for short, is a martial artist and officer of the Varia Squad.

Lussuria is a tall and well-built guy with bulging muscles. First of all, he stands out with his colourful hairstyle: his short hair contrasts with a green long strand hanging on his right side. In the future, a bright red Mohawk is also added. He always wears dark red-rimmed sunglasses over his eyes. In clothing, he prefers a long, open-fronted Varia cloak, over which he always wears a bright orange-coloured fur scarf boa. Luss has a steel insert on his left knee, which he uses to block the physical attacks of his opponents.

In character, Lussuria fully reflects the meaning of his name (Italian for ‘lust’), always behaving in a slightly frivolous, flirtatious and defiant manner. In addition, Lussa has a tendency to be a necrophiliac, such as when, in the Battle for the Ring of the Sun against Ryohei, he said that he likes ‘cold, unmoving organs’. Nevertheless, in the right situation, Lussuria can be quite collected and serious, as well as caring towards other members of Varia. This is why the latter refer to Luss as ‘Big Sis Lussuria’. By disposition, he is a very cheerful fellow, and is rarely seen without a smile.

To a certain extent, Lussuria honours Thai culture, practising Muay Thai style in combat, eating Thai food and so on. The story often references his good taste in fashion, which along with his flamboyant image makes Lussuriya a metrosexual.

Muay Thai: Lussuria is Varia's expert on martial arts. His strong body and special stamina allows him to increase his Muay Thai skill, allowing Luss to use 8 limbs in combat: two arms, two elbows, two knees and two feet.

As each of the members of the Varia symbolise one of the seven deadly sins, Lussuria correlates with ‘lust’. Moreover, in Italian, his name ‘Lussuria’ means exactly ‘lust’.

His hobbies are fashion shows and the film industry.
